reasons: Cited Section 18.1 matches the preferred position on every material term: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year.
Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request, satisfying the remaining preferred element; primacy and cancellation notice are additional benefits to us.
Compliant status is correctly claimed with no redline and no comment, as expected for a compliant finding; deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
